name: Horizon Valley School
sampleDataNotice: Demonstration content: the school name, descriptions, history and achievements in this app are illustrative samples, not verified school records. Replace them in src/data before the exhibition.

hero.heading: EXPLORE OUR SCHOOL
hero.subtitle: More than a school. A world of discoveries.
hero.description: Step inside our virtual campus, explore our facilities, discover our achievements, and experience the future of education with AI.

exhibition.title: Welcome, exhibition visitor!
exhibition.message: You scanned our banner – the whole campus is now in your hands. Walk through nine locations, tap the glowing points to learn more, and ask our AI guide anything about what you see.
steps: Open the virtual campus and start at the Main Entrance
Drag, swipe or zoom to look around each location
Tap glowing markers for stories, photos and videos
Ask the AI guide – it knows where you are

about.summary: Horizon Valley School is a sample school profile used to demonstrate the AI Virtual School Explorer. It describes a co-educational day school with science and computer laboratories, a library, a playground, an auditorium and a school garden.

achievements: Sample: Regular participation in inter-school science exhibitions
Sample: Annual sports day with house championships
Sample: Student-run eco club maintaining the school garden
